connectsTitle: Connected to the rest of the business

connects.text: Quotations and sales orders are drafted from what was agreed.
Purchase orders and requests for quotation are drafted for you to check.
Reports you ask for can be saved or added to a dashboard.
Next steps become tasks on the customer's page.
Meetings in Meet, calendar events and messages all start from a draft.

faq.q: Can the assistant send or pay something without me?
faq.a: No. It drafts, and nothing is sent, posted or paid until you confirm. Each draft needs its own yes.

faq.q: Can it see records I am not allowed to open?
faq.a: No. Answers come only from records you may open. It acts as you, with your permissions, and every action is recorded.

faq.q: How do I know a draft matches what was said?
faq.a: Each draft says where it came from. Tap it to hear that moment in the recording.

cta.title: Bring a meeting, leave with the work drafted.
cta.body: Start free, or book a demo and we will turn a recorded meeting into minutes, a quotation and tasks.
